input.title: National CERT warns of AI-powered cyberattacks on banks
input.summary: A national CERT has issued a warning about AI-powered cyberattacks targeting banks and critical infrastructure, signaling a potential cyber threat to large financial participants.
evidence_quotes: National CERT Warns of AI-Powered Cyberattacks on Banks and Critical Infrastructure
input.notes: headline_only. Warning issued by a national CERT about AI-powered cyberattacks targeting banks and critical infrastructure broadly — matches XE-CYBER Step 1 (cyberattack at a large participant). No specific bank, attack, or outage confirmed; certainty set to 1 (official warning/announcement, not a confirmed incident). Reach set to 1 (group — banks broadly) rather than 2 as no major named participant is identified. Source is a secondary outlet (PhoneWorld), not the CERT itself. Confidence lowered due to headline-only content and lack of detail.
